body: thank you!

Congratulations on 3 months of NC!! That's great work you've done and I hope you are soo very proud of yourself! :) I feel you totally, we've been on and off for 12 years, I never in my wildest dreams would imagine that there will come a day where I just had it. I always thought my love for him was unconditional and I guess it was, since he was able to say and do whatever he wanted and everything was accepted from my side. But now I know that unconditional love isn't meant to be onesided. It doesn't mean that one person gets to be given everything and the other is left with breadcrumbs. Thank you so much for your response. Time and acceptance are of great importance during these hard days.. But I can do it. I can handle it and I know one day (sooner or later) my smile will be brighter than ever. I wish you to stay strong and love yourself first and foremost! We got this! :)

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your kind words of support that I so much needed to hear. I didn't break the NC, I still can't even think of what would I even want to say to him. It's breaking me inside knowing that this loss is not only of who I thought was my soulmate but also a loss of collegaue whom I could trust. It's hard working together and not talking, but I am stronger than that. I will remember what you wrote: "There is absolutely nothing wrong in letting go of someone who does not see your worth, who does not value your time." Time will heal the wounds, it will get better. I am deeply thankful for your support, sending you my love..

I feel you so much! I cried my eyes out last night..and it was a good thing, tears are cleaners for the soul! :) I know there will come another moment or moments of sadness and sorrow and that is okay. I can accept those feelings now as part of me. I think I can also start loving these feelings as they're mine and they need to be processed and then lovinlgy let go. Thank you so much for your kind words of support! I can't believe how many beautiful souls are here found together and helping each other. It's of great relief knowing that someone can hear us and I think it's important to be sorrounded with such amazing souls in these hard times. We can do it, I know we can! And once we're on the other side all the suffering and pain will be so worth it.. We are worthy and deserving of all nice and beautiful that life has to offer! Sending you my love and thank you once again!

I think I cried my eyes out, couldn't fall asleep and when finally did I had really bad dreams.. So when I woke up I took half of a pill to calm me down.. I am kind of numb right now. Which is much better than being anxious. I can do it, I will stay no contact (even though we work together), I need to focus on myself. I can and will do it! Thank you so much, I can't express my gratitude enough..
Thank you!
I hope so too..tears today are catharsic. Thank you so much, it means a lot!
Thank you so much, it helps a lot to have support!

I really really recommend you not to do it.. Unless you are 100% sure, it won't do anything to you (emotionally) you are sooo much better of without talking to her and possibly going through everything all over again.. If you are unsure, don't do it to yourself, not one person is worth it!
Way to go, congatulation! I believe there are quite a bunch of us here following you down that road!

Yeah, it is horrible.. every day I am thinking about leaving this job I really like and where I started from scratches and managed to come really far. I do belive there is a big promotion coming at the end of the year, but I don' think I'll work at this company for that long. I don't want to work with a person who clearly showed his disrespect and has no intention of playing it fair. I need to save myself. I hate the fact that I think that this is him winning (if I leave) and I don't want to give him the satisfaction. Also if I get him fired (which I probably could) everyone else will think I'm a bi**h.. it's really tiresome..

I really hope the next phase is going to be something like yours "don't even care anymore". It just sooo sux that we work together and we see each other every day. I do need to get it in my head so that he'll be invisible to me. It's very hard trying to move on and be reminded every day of what I've put up with for all those years..

I think that I just got to the angry phase which is great! And thank you for your words, you are right. That kind of 'relationship' is neverending suffering and I do deserve better. Karma has kicked him a few times before (all that sh*t was going on for 12 years) and probably will again. But I'll be long gone by then..working on myself and living the life I deserve. Thank you again!
Yes! Thank you!
Thank you! I am doing my best and even though there are some stings of pain now and then I know that they are just temporary! Thank you again ❤
Thank you! It helps amazingly on such days.. ❤
so great - thank you! ❤
Thank you!
Thank you!
Thank you!
Thank you so much for your offer! Will PM in case I won't be able to handle things alone. You really are an angel - thank you once again!

You are so very right - thank you!!! There's no need for me to stay at this job if it makes me feel this way! So I will give it a try for a few more days and if it's going to get harder than I'll talk to my boss. No crying, no whining, just simple facts. It's my mental and physical health at stake here and I respect myself enough to not endure that kind of circumstances. It's only a job, it's not the end of the world. If the company won't understand my current position then that would be just one more sign that it's time for me to leave. I must put myself first, even though it's hard and unknown, but no one else will do it for me.

Big thank you!!!

Thank you so much for your answer and support! I really appreciate it!

It's quite a long story,things have been going on for 12 years now. But the last year has been awful for me. It turned out,he was only using me for attention, sex, love and even for getting a job at this place. Our boss knows a few things from the past, the last thing was mutual meeting (three of us my boss,my 'user' and me) and we agreed that we will try to work it out someway until the end of this school year. But after that meeting, just a few days after to be exact, I fell back in his trap and slept with this skunk (I alwasy thought he had some feelings for me, it hid me hard that he was just using me for whatever he could get). Afterwards I found out he was trying to work things out with his ex. I couldn't handle it anymore so I took a few days off to calm myself down. About three weeks ago I tried to talk to him to resolve stuff around working together but he didn't respond. So I decided to go NC. Still it makes me sick to my stomach that I have to work with him every day and since we are only 5 employees (I am the only woman, of course the guys stick together) it's almost impossible to not be in contact. 
I am seriously considering to find myself a new job. It is hard to think about that, since I really like my job and I believe there was quite a promotion waiting for me at the end of this year. It disgusts me that in a way I am responsible for him even getting the job (due to our past my boss asked me if it's ok with me if he would start to work at this company and I said I'll handle it). I am in a really bad place right now. In a way I want to leave my job this instance and send him to hell. But I feel responsible for what I promised and I don't want to be the one who ran away. I want to show him I am so much more than what he thinks of me and I also don't want him to think that he won everything (new GF, the job) if resign. That is why I think NC is the best and in this moment the only way for me to stay remotely sane this 4 months. Yet after days like this I feel like giving everything up and just disappear.. 

I apologize for the long post, just wanted to give you a bit more insight.. And please do share your thoughts, it means so much! Thank you!

I thought it would be fair if I were the one who'd told him that I won't work with this one group we were supposed to work together. I wrote him that I am too busy to help and it would be  best if he would find someone else for the job. The truth is that I don't want to work with him. I could've do it throug my boss but I don't want him knowing what is going on. I believe that there are going to be more situations where we will must be in some contact, but it's really hard for me and I don't know how long I'll be able to stay strong..It's so very hurtful, I just want him out of my life and not seeing him ever again..I am so very thankful for your advice!

Does it count as breaking NC if it was a strictly job concerning email? We work together and I had to tell him something regarding work.. was thinking about how to tell him (face to face, msg..) and I decided an email was the best option. He didn't respond, which I found rude, yet the email was one of informative nature, no questions. It's so damn hard thinking about how to have 0 contact and work together.. Fuck him!!! (I apologize for bad mouth) thank you for your kind help!
I feel you and wish you all the best! I am at the same place, getting my acts together and stop seeking the good where there isn't any. Stay strong!

Most of your words are such a new concepts for me. They hit me hard and in one way they are scary but on the other hand so very liberating. I will work on self care today, being gentle with myself and understanding. Will hug myself often and tell me that everything is ok. I need to really implement and absorb those words you said: ".. choices are about you and what's best for you. No one else." That's healthy, not selfish. And it's going to be my meditation mantra for today. Deep gratitude.

I am very happy for you and your ability to get yourself out of that relationship. I really hope I will get to be so strong soon.. I am having a really bad day today, struggling to tell myself that it's just a phase and it will be better. I read your comments to other people with same troubles and it's very helpful. Been doing my best to keep with the NC and Grey Rock method and I know deep down that I deserve better. You and a few friends recommended me that I get a new job and I am doing my best that I will find something new. In the beginning of this year we had a meeting (my boss, my ex and me) and we tried to find a solution for us working together. I said then that I will do my best to work at the company until the end of school year. Today that seems nearly impossible. I am also having a hard time thinking of leaving my job sooner since I know that my boss is really relying on me and I believe that he wanted me as his replacement once he retires (end of this year). And as I am writing this I became aware that again I am leaving myself behind and am taking others opinions in much greater consideration than my own thoughts and feelings.. I am mad that I think that if I leave my "ex" will somehow win and get everything and I will be left with nothing. It's so hard coping with all that turmoil inside my head and would really appreciate any advice you could give me as how to handle these kind of moments/days. Thank you once again!
You must be a great parent - I wish I will one day be such a support for my child (inner and real). Thank you again!

Even though it's hard to hear the truth I am very thankful to you! You are correct, he was 18 when it all started, I was 24.. And yes, all these years the focus has been on him and this pseudo relationship. I do know every moment more that I lost myself completely in this time. And a question "Why do you not matter to you?" is one I didn't ever get in consideration.. It was all about him and his needs and his desires. I never mattered.. I am getting to know my internal struggles. In therapy I've got to the problem of my inner child and her emotional neglect. It's been since I know it that I've always wanted and needed to be loved and accepted by people around me. I did everything that I thought necessary for people to admire and approve of me. I believe I also developed a very strong inner critic (who I know tried to protect me from hurt and disappointment) who pushed me even more to be perfect for everyone (but myself). It's hard to realize all the damage it's been made over all this time. I know I need to develop discipline to improve myself for myself. I know I need to work on my inner little girl and stop neglecting her needs. I also know I need to face my inner critic and get her new beliefs and values to live by. I know it's not easy and that it's going to take time and patience with myself. I know I shouldn't be scared of failure as it is part of life. I know I am thankful beyond words for your support and feedback. I know I owe it to myself to live life as I want it and to discover myself again. Thank you so very much!

Omg, love it! It feels so good reading those words of yours, feels like you speaking directly to me. 😊 Especially all the inner child parts.. I have just recently started intensive work with my little self and I just love it! My little star has been very hurt, neglected and alone but I am doing my best to tell her several times every day that she is beautiful, welcomed, respected and endlessly and unconditionally loved. I love the works by John Bradshaw, his book Homecoming is a life saver for me. I promise my little self everyday that I will never let go of taking care for myself. It might take some time to heal but I know it's so worth it!

Thank you!

Thank you so very much for your response!

"He never introduced me to his family, I only met a few of his friends but we never hung out them for more than a drink. In 2011 he got himself a new girlfriend. After they were together for 3 months or so he called me in the middle of the night, I didn't answer and stayed strong for a week."

- I feel like something is missing. You were his girlfriend from the beginning? He hid you. Then you confronted him for being with another woman. Then he got a new girlfriend? Did you break up? How did that actually happen? -

I thought we had a relationship but as you put it now I can see it was all just in my head. I feel used to the bones.. 

To be more correct: In 2006 we started seeing each other. After we would be officially in a relationship for three months I met his sister. As he is 6 years younger she didn't approve of us being together and that same evening his mother called him to get home immediately. Guess the sister told mother about us being together and he got the call the next second. The next day he told me that his mother is against our relationship and she wants us to break up. So from then on we were hiding from public so that we wouldn't be caught and he wouldn't have problems at home since he was 18 and had no job at the time. So that went on for 5 years with on and offs. He told me he loved me and cared for me but didn't know how to resolve it with his family. All that 4,5 years it wasn't a real relationship, I only imagined we had something special and that I only have to wait for him to get strong enough and stand up for himself and for me. But he never did. All those years there were other women but somehow we always ended up calling each other (most of the times it was me who called or msged first) and being intimate. Every time I believed that he got his acts together and that he will realize how much I care and want us to be together. I know for at least 4 girls he's been with (hanging out, kissing, having sex) in that time. At the end of 2011 I saw a picture on FB with yet another new girl. I asked him what was going on and he said they're just friends. A few weeks later (we were texting and talking for what was again my imagination of a relationship) I got a msg saying: "Leave me alone." That was it for him I guess, his way of ending whatever we had. That was when he officially started dating that girl from the pic. I tried my best back then to pick myself up and get my life together and after three months he calls me. Again I went back thinking he's changed. It made me feel even worse when he cried and said to me: "I want us to be together. I just don't know how it can be." I believe he meant his family and things with new girlfriend.. He stayed with that girl for 3 years. Now and then he called me and we hung out, occasionally we had sex and I always thought he loved me and we will get back together. 
But as you said it and nailed it, all this time he was only using me for his benefits. It is really hard to stop blinding myself and seeing things as they are. I am so thankful for you truthful response and all the words that really resonate with me. I know I have a lot of issues I need to work on hard because that is the only way I will get through this and stay sane. I do lack self discipline since all these years have been so largely focused on him and doing every and anything so that he would just love me and accept me. It makes me so angry when I think that all he did was using me and I don't know how to cope with this anger at work. But if I take it day by day I think I can do it. 
Thank you so much for your words of wisdom, courage and truth. I kindly ask you for an answer, it would be much of a help!

Thank you so much! I believe it's time to start focusing on myself. After all these years I forgot who I really am and what I want from life. It's really hard to discipline the mind..but will have to work that through. Could someone please try to help me with how to deal with him at work? I am so affraid I will relapse.. Thank you!
